description: Default permissions for the main ontology workbench window. `core:default` was replaced by the five core sets below: it expanded to nine, and `core:image`, `core:resources`, `core:menu` and `core:tray` were granted to a webview that never called them. The webview's only core-plugin calls are `listen` from `@tauri-apps/api/event` and `getVersion` from `@tauri-apps/api/app`; everything else goes through app-defined commands, which capabilities do not gate. `core:path`, `core:window` and `core:webview` are retained without an observed frontend caller — dropping them is a further narrowing that needs installed-app proof, not a guess.
